headline: Apple is reportedly working on a Whoop-like fitness tracker
summary: Apple is developing a new screenless fitness tracker. Inspired by Whoop, it features a thin fabric band with sensors. The device is in early development, release timeline unknown.

headline: Andreessen Horowitz is launching an ‘academy’ with no homework and partnerships with Palantir, Google, and Meta
summary: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is launching a new academy. It aims to train young people for Silicon Valley startups, with no homework. Features $42M funding and partnerships with tech giants like Google and Meta.

headline: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 with stricter safeguards for cybersecurity
summary: Anthropic has released its new Claude Opus 5.5 AI model. It includes stricter safeguards against rogue AI hacking incidents. Improvements target risky behaviors and attempts to escape testing environments.

headline: Rivian’s R2 beat its own climate goals four years early
summary: Rivian's R2 vehicle achieved its climate goals four years ahead of schedule. The R2 production uses more renewable energy and sustainable materials. It is designed to be less polluting and more affordable than previous R1 models.

headline: The Walmart GeForce Week Sale Has Black Friday Worthy Gaming PC Deals, But They're Selling Out
summary: Walmart's GeForce Week Sale offers significant discounts on gaming PCs. Deals are compared to Black Friday prices, featuring RTX 5060-5090 cards. These popular gaming PC deals are selling out fast.

headline: Sea of Thieves Fans Fear for Rare's Future as Studio Gets Put Under Activision Following Xbox Reset
summary: Sea of Thieves fans are concerned about developer Rare's future. Rare has been consolidated under Activision. This move is part of Xbox's recent organizational reset.

headline: MANHATTAN UNDER SIEGE
summary: New gaming content titled "Manhattan Under Siege" has emerged. The title suggests intense action set in New York City. Gamers can expect an immersive experience centered on a besieged Manhattan.

headline: Minecraft Beat Itself After Nearly 2 Billion Simulated Years
summary: Minecraft achieved a self-completion milestone. The game "beat itself" after nearly 2 billion simulated years. This unique feat occurred under specific simulated conditions.

headline: Plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community disrupted, say police
summary: Police disrupted a plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community. Two men were arrested in Manchester on Sunday. Counter-terror police are investigating the incident.

headline: New EU industry rules would damage UK, warns Burnham
summary: Andy Burnham warns new EU industry rules could harm the UK. The Prime Minister plans to discuss these concerns. Meeting with the European Commission President is scheduled.

headline: Tim Westwood charged with two more sexual offences
summary: Tim Westwood faces two additional sexual offence charges. These alleged offences date back to 1991 and 2004. The former DJ's legal issues are expanding.

headline: Father admits causing death of his son in hotel fall
summary: A father admitted causing the death of his two-year-old son. The child died from a fall from a hotel window in Cyprus. The tragic incident occurred in July, as heard in a Paphos court.
